Name: BS's New Watermelons
Author: baddiestardew
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install Json Assets.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use
[/size]Download Json Assets and this mod and run the game using SMAPI.


[size=5]More info:
[/size]This mod is fairly balanced, but not completely due to how short they take to grow. The seeds take four days to grow in summer and can be bought from Pierre. They can be placed in a keg and preserves jar and are a loved gift to some people. AS OF V2: It should be okay to use in a vanilla playthrough. They don't make much profit because they have a high chance of getting a double harvest, but still be warned they can make ALOT of money very quickly
